description:
DuckDB is an in-process SQL OLAP Database Management System

DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system.
It is designed to be fast, reliable and easy to use.
DuckDB provides a rich SQL dialect, with support far beyond basic SQL.
This is a bug fix release for various issues discovered after we released v2.0.0.
Please also refer to the announcement blog post: https://duckdb.org/2026/11/20/announcing-duckdb-201.html
